entities.name: gateOn
entities.description: A function `Sig Bool -> Sig Gate` that turns any boolean condition into a note, a rising edge is a press and falling edge a release; shipped in synth.ges's public 'Gates' section.

entities.name: gateRepeat
entities.description: A drafted second name, `gateRepeat p hold`, a metronome with a note length implemented as a pure `map` of `ticks`; implemented, tested, then withdrawn.

entities.name: doc/beginner.md
entities.description: The beginner course document whose lesson 3 used to apologise for teaching envelopes via a `wrap` trick because proper envelope tools needed notes to react to.

entities.name: lesson 3
entities.description: The section of doc/beginner.md that keeps the exponential `wrap` envelope as its spine and now also teaches `perc` and `adsr` fed by `gateOn`.

entities.name: Adsr
entities.description: One of the library's proper envelope tools mentioned as needing a note's timing to react to.

entities.name: adsr
entities.description: An envelope tool that consumes a `Sig Gate`; its docstring/usage treats a played gate and a generated one as the same thing.

entities.name: perc
entities.description: One of the library's envelope tools that reads a note's timing from a keyboard; now taught in lesson 3 fed by `gateOn`.

entities.name: Sig Gate
entities.description: The signal type that envelope tools like `adsr` and `perc` need; previously only producible from a played note.

entities.name: Gate
entities.description: A type defined as `Gate Int Int`, holding the sample a note began and the sample it was released, 1-based, zero meaning nothing, documented in audio.ges.

entities.name: audio.ges
entities.description: Document defining `Gate := Gate Int Int` and its zero-meaning-nothing convention.

entities.name: voices bank
entities.description: The machinery that produced gate signals from notes, via `gateAt`/`offAt` channels, filled by a score or a keyboard.

entities.name: gateAt
entities.description: A channel of the `voices` bank that helps produce gate signals from notes.

entities.name: offAt
entities.description: A channel of the `voices` bank that helps produce gate signals from notes, alongside `gateAt`.

entities.name: adsrOf
entities.description: A function whose docstring calls it 'the whole envelope, as arithmetic', showing the envelope itself does not care about notes.

entities.name: sine.ges
entities.description: Document that demonstrates `adsrOf` holding one note between two constants.

entities.name: synth.ges
entities.description: Document containing the public 'Gates' section where `gateOn` is defined beside the envelopes that consume it.

entities.name: GateEdge
entities.description: The zip record used inside `gateOn`'s fold, following `SvfIn`'s precedent.

entities.name: gateEdge
entities.description: Internal helper function used as the folding function in `gateOn`'s `scan`.

entities.name: gateHeld
entities.description: Internal helper below `internal`, part of `gateOn`'s machinery.

entities.name: SvfIn
entities.description: A precedent record structure that `GateEdge` follows.

entities.name: internal
entities.description: The marker/module under which `gateOn`'s helper machinery (GateEdge, gateEdge, gateHeld) is hidden, refusing to be named directly from a program.

entities.name: internals.py
entities.description: Tool that derives the faces of internal machinery with no table to maintain.

entities.name: scan
entities.description: The single fold construct over one flat record used to implement `gateOn`, existing in the static fragment.

entities.name: spec/exclamation.md
entities.description: Document describing the repaired `!` marker, whose spelling `gateOn`'s example usage leans on.
The exclamation marker construct that takes a lambda as its head and lifts it over a ramp, used in `gateOn` examples like metronomes.

entities.name: phase
entities.description: A ramp-generating function used in the metronome example `phase 2.0` combined with `gateOn`.

entities.name: lfo
entities.description: An example signal used with `gateOn` to make a note play while the LFO is high.

entities.name: wrap
entities.description: An envelope trick/arithmetic phase technique used throughout the beginner course before `gateOn` existed, now the course's own idea about timing as arithmetic.

entities.name: on = 0 convention
entities.description: The convention that a gate's `on` value of zero means never-played, left untouched by `gateOn`'s introduction.

entities.name: test_a_phase_comparison_is_a_metronome
entities.description: A test verifying that a phase comparison via `gateOn` behaves as a metronome.

entities.name: test_a_gate_holds_and_releases
entities.description: A test verifying that a gate produced by `gateOn` holds and releases correctly.

entities.name: test_a_condition_is_a_note
entities.description: A test verifying that any boolean condition becomes a playable note via `gateOn`.

entities.name: test/test_synthlib.py
entities.description: The test file containing the gateOn-related tests.

entities.name: dust
entities.description: An example name that earned its existence by being irreducible, contrasted with `gateRepeat` which was not irreducible.

entities.name: stage 5
entities.description: A migration stage that will carry `gateOn`'s one node of fold state across a live edit, treated as a held note surviving the edit.

entities.name: static fragment
entities.description: The part of the system where `gateOn`'s single `scan` construct currently lives.
